notes.title: First Announcement
notes.content:
Dear players and friends, I am glad that you have paid attention to this game, this game is my personal independent work, it is during my self-study, the scene created based on my school, you may encounter many bugs in your play, so I am deeply sorry for affecting your game experience.
Like you, I am also dissatisfied with this game, I will continue to learn after the launch, continue to update this game, and it will always be free, you can play this game at any time, I wish you a happy life!
